title: Unhappy!
text: Unhappy!. Not durable at all. Not waterproof at all. Tore in multiple places and the fabric wore out very quickly. Bought two and regret it. Did not protect my couch at all so it was a waste of money.

product_metadata.title: WOMACO Couch Cushion Covers, Waterproof Cushion Sofa Cover, Spandex Couch Seat Protector - White, X-Large
features: Furniture Cushion Slipcover - Our couch cushion cover will give your furniture a new look if your furniture looks a bit broken or not so new. It can also protect your furniture from the dent, stains, accidental food＆liquid spills, wear, tear, scratch and hair. Keep your furniture brand new. Perfect for homes with kids and pets.

PERFECT FIT - 85% Polyester and 15% Spandex soft, no fading, durable as well as high stretch.Have elastic band all around the edge, held in place the cushion cover by the elastic ring in the back, stay in place and did not have to adjust it at all when you stand up.

How To Choose The Right Size - Please refer to the measuring guide in the product images to measure your cushion before purchase. Our couch cushion slipcover has great elasticity, fits for more than 90% cushions. The same applies to the T-shaped sofa cushion.

WIDE USAGE - You can use it to cover not only the seat cushions of your sofa but also the back cushions as long as they can be separated from the sofa. Even if your sofa or chair is wooden, this cover can still function well as long as you have soft cushions.
EASY CARE - Machine washable, wash at a temperature around 30 degrees Celsius, mild laundry detergents are advised, please do not bleach. Do not iron.
